source: warps of logical work. Those 1,920 warps are not all resident at once. Blocks are dispatched across ZXNAME0000XZ as resources become available. How many blocks fit on one ZXNAME0001XZ depends on the device’s architectural limits and this kernel’s resource requirements, especially registers and shared memory.[1,2]
zh: 逻辑工作的扭曲。这 1,920 个扭曲并非同时全部驻留。当资源可用时，块将在 ZXNAME0000XZ 上调度。一个 ZXNAME0001XZ 上可以容纳多少个块取决于设备的架构限制和该内核的资源需求，尤其是寄存器和共享内存。[1,2]
